We are incredibly grateful to Dr. Ravindra puttaswamamaiah for the life-changing total knee replacement surgery performed on my brother,

What stood out to us from the very first consultation was the doctor’s confidence, honesty, and transparency. He never made unrealistic promises or sugar-coated the situation. Instead, he clearly explained what was possible, what challenges lay ahead, and what outcomes we could realistically expect. This honest approach gave us immense confidence and trust in his expertise.

My brother’s case was particularly complex and challenging, but Dr.ravindra sir handled it with exceptional skill and precision. Thanks to his expertise and dedication, my brother is now able to walk with support—a milestone we once thought might never be possible.

My mother was very scared about my brother’s surgery, but the doctor spent nearly an hour in the very first consultation patiently explaining everything and reassuring her. His calm confidence helped her trust the decision, and we are truly grateful for his guidance.

We sincerely thank Dr.ravindra puttaswamaiah sir for his guidance, commitment, and outstanding surgical skills. He has transformed my brother’s life and given our family renewed hope. We wholeheartedly recommend him to anyone seeking orthopedic care. Thank you dr ravindra puttaswamy sir

reviews.snippet:
Thank you, Dr. Ravindra Sir.

I consulted Dr. Ravindra for a knee replacement surgery for one of my family members. Given the patient's age and condition, we were naturally anxious about the procedure. From our very first consultation, Dr. Ravindra put all our concerns to rest with his calm, compassionate, and confident approach.

He explained every aspect of the knee replacement surgery in detail, including the procedure, expected recovery, and rehabilitation process. His patience in answering all our questions and his constant encouragement gave the patient the confidence to undergo the surgery.

The surgery was performed successfully, and we are extremely grateful to Dr. Ravindra and his entire team for their exceptional care. The hospital staff were professional, attentive, and supportive throughout the stay. The post-operative care was excellent, and the physiotherapy guidance helped the patient begin walking and recovering with confidence.

Even after discharge, Dr. Ravindra's team regularly followed up on the patient's progress, ensuring a smooth recovery. Their dedication and genuine concern made a significant difference in our overall experience.

Dr. Ravindra is not only an outstanding orthopedic surgeon but also a humble and compassionate human being. I have complete confidence in him and his team, and I wholeheartedly recommend him to anyone seeking expert orthopedic care, especially for knee replacement surgery.

Thank you once again, Sir, for giving our family a new lease on life.
❤️

Dr. Ravindra is extremely approachable, friendly, and patient in explaining the condition and treatment plan clearly. He made me feel comfortable and confident about the procedure. His assistant was equally supportive, caring, and always ready to help with any questions or concerns. The coordination and care provided were truly commendable. Overall, I am very satisfied with the treatment and the excellent care I received. I highly recommend Medicover Hospital Whitefield and Dr. Ravindra to anyone seeking orthopedic care.
